title: Marek's shack
comment: The only warm cue in the game: G mixolydian, a small plucked figure like a cheap guitar slightly out of tune, a music-box tune that is itself tuned sharp against it. 90 bpm in 6/4 (bar 4 s), 8 bars. Not cosy: every fourth bar an eb drone sits under the G, the flat sixth of a key that was almost home.

layers.comment: the heart of the cue: a plucked arpeggio, uneven in level and a little flat, per-note pitch wobble
layers.pattern: <[g3 d4 b4 d4 a4 d4] [c4 g4 e4 g4 d5 g4] [g3 d4 b4 d4 f4 d4] [d4 a4 f4 a4 c5 a4]>

layers.comment: a small tune on a music box, tuned 18 cents sharp of the guitar; the human touch, and the wrongness
a soft held chord under it all: the stove
a quiet eb under the last chord of each phrase: the island is still outside; the director may drop it while Marek talks
a chair, a floorboard: a knock or two per loop
